title: The Cyber-Bonsai
summary: An interactive WebGL2 sculpture pairing a twisted bronze circuit-tree trunk and emerald PCB soil with glowing orange cathodes and plum blossoms.
description: An interactive WebGL2 sculpture and 30-second studio film. Two warm orange cathode tubes illuminate an emerald circuit board beneath a twisted bronze bonsai trunk as glass shoots carry optical data pulses to five-petalled plum blossoms.
